annotations.title: Get a private link to send files

description: Returns a private web page where the user uploads files for Nikita at VIDEO DEPT. from their own computer or phone: footage, photos, logos, references or documents, up to 20 files and 20 GB in all. Use it when the user wants to send files that aren't online. Give the user the link; they open it and choose the files themselves. The link works for 24 hours. Only Nikita can open the files, and they are deleted from the upload storage after 30 days. Making the link sends nothing.

about.description: Optional: the brief number (like A-12), the quote number (like Q-12) or the project name these files are for.

email.description: The user's email address, where Nikita can reply.
